craft_notes: Sthāyin: hand-foot unity. Rows: within then deem. Read aloud: inward turn.

lines: But within, in breath-home-deed joining: the voice-engine;
by that, in engine's seat, in hand, what going, that too
is foot-engine's alone doing — so deem; by that deed-countless
to this height the lustrous clings — they say.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antaḥ prāṇāśrayakarmānusaṃdhes tu vāgindriyam tena indriyādhiṣṭhāne haste yat gamanaṃ tad api pādendriyasyaiva karma iti mantavyam tena karmānantyam api na indriyānantyam āvahet iyati rājasasya upaśleṣakatvam ity āhuḥ
